view_range.cut.hint: Height of the cut plane above the level. Elements crossing it are drawn cut.
view_range.bottom.hint: Bottom of the range, relative to the level. Zero or negative values are allowed.
view_range.depth.hint: How far the view looks below the bottom. Zero or more.
view_range.err.number: Enter a length in each field
view_range.err.not_finite: Enter a length in each field
view_range.err.cut_not_above_bottom: The cut plane must be above the bottom
view_range.err.top_below_cut: The top of the range must not be below the cut plane
